title: Transforming road maintenance with vehicle-mounted inspections, AI analysis and connected workflows
summary: With 39% of US roads in poor or mediocre condition, agencies can't afford to wait for problems to appear. Learn how AI-powered analysis, mobile mapping and connected workflows are enabling proactive maintenance—reducing costs and keeping roads safer for longer.
